name: The Seven Ravens · The Feather Trail
description: The seven brothers are not at the table: they are ravens waiting on the glass mountain. The Storyteller hands out clue Feathers among the players; anyone holding one cannot use their ability. The Sister collects Feathers night after night while the Father moves them around, the Moon falsifies counts and the Sun slows the search. Good wins by gathering every Feather; Evil wins if the Sister dies first or the seventh night ends with the trail incomplete.

info.name: Sister
info.ability: Each night, choose another player and collect as many Feathers from them as your capacity allows. If you die while any Feather remains, Evil wins.
info.lore: An imagined sister walking to the glass mountain along fallen feathers. Every clue recovered brings her closer to her seven brothers and farther from home.

info.name: Seven Cups
info.ability: At dawn, if any Feather changed hands overnight without being collected, you learn one of the affected players, chosen by the Storyteller.
info.lore: Seven imagined cups on a stone table. Someone drank from one tonight, and the dregs betray the passage, not the name.

info.name: Repentant Mother
info.ability: Once per game, when another player would die by execution, you may prevent that death. All of their Feathers move to you and your vote does not count the following day.
info.lore: An imagined mother who shoulders another's guilty wish. She saves one life and keeps the clues, and the silence they bring.

info.name: Lost Little Bone
info.ability: Each night, you may choose another living player who holds Feathers. They may use their ability tonight despite them, and 1 of their Feathers moves to you.
info.lore: An imagined bone that once opened a mountain and was lost on the road. It still serves as a key, but charges its weight in feathers.

info.ability: Each night, before anyone else, choose a source and a destination other than yourself. If the source holds a Feather and the destination can receive one, move 1 Feather. You learn whether it happened.
info.lore: An imagined father whose angry wish turned his sons into ravens. He kills nobody: he redistributes blame until no truth survives a night.

category.description: Rules the Storyteller resolves before any character acts.

info.name: The Feather Trail
info.ability: At the start of the first night the Storyteller hands out the trail's Feathers: 5 with 7 or 8 players, 6 with 9 or 10 and 7 from 11 upwards. The Sister and the Father never receive Feathers, and anyone still holding one cannot use their ability.
info.howToRun: First give one Feather to each bearer, between 3 and 6 players other than the Sister and the Father. Then add a second Feather to some of them until the game's exact total is reached. Public conditions for the split: at least three Good bearers, at least two Evil ones, two or three Feathers on Evil players, at least one Evil player with no Feathers who can bluff, and the Morning Star always without Feathers. Keep the tokens visible in the grimoire only: every bearer knows their own amount and nobody else's. While a player holds a Feather they cannot use their ability. Never change the split mid-game to favour a side.

action: Choose 3 to 6 players other than the Sister and the Father and place one Feather on each.
Keep at least one Feather for the next step if the total is not distributed yet.
communicate: Show each bearer how many Feathers they hold, and nobody else.

category.description: Rules the Storyteller resolves before any character acts.

info.name: Stacked Clues
info.ability: Right after handing out the trail, the Storyteller adds a second Feather to some bearers until the game's exact total is reached.
info.howToRun: The total is 5 with 7 or 8 players, 6 with 9 or 10 and 7 from 11 upwards. Add second Feathers until it is met exactly; the app accepts no other split.

action: Add a second Feather to as many bearers as needed to complete the game's total.
The total is 5 with 7 or 8 players, 6 with 9 or 10 and 7 from 11 upwards.
communicate: Show each affected bearer their new amount again.

category.description: Rules the Storyteller resolves before any character acts.

info.name: Feathers of the Dead
info.ability: When a player dies, every Feather they hold is collected: it leaves the table and counts toward the trail. No Feather stays on a dead player.
info.howToRun: Remove their Feathers as soon as the death is confirmed and announce how many were collected, never whose or which character. If an ability prevents the death, nothing is collected.

category.description: Rules determining when the game ends and who wins.

info.name: The Trail's Ending
info.ability: Good wins as soon as no Feather remains in play. Evil wins if the Sister dies while the trail is incomplete, or if the seventh night ends without every Feather gathered. Neither killing the Father nor the living-player count ends the game.
info.howToRun: Check the trail after every resolution. If no Feather is left on the table, Good wins immediately. If the Sister dies while any remains, Evil wins at that moment. If the seventh day begins with Feathers uncollected, Evil wins. Any other death, including the Father's or every Evil player's, leaves the game open.

info.name: Angry Wish
info.ability: The trail starts with one extra Feather: the Storyteller adds a second Feather to a bearer who holds only one.
info.howToRun: After handing out the trail, choose a bearer holding exactly one Feather and add a second. The game's total rises by one and that Feather must also be collected for Good to win.

category.description: Optional rules that gently tilt the tale toward Good.

info.name: Dawn Light
info.ability: During the first night the Sister starts with Impulse: her first collection that night gets +1.
info.howToRun: Before characters act, place Impulse on the Sister. It expires at dawn like the Morning Star's Impulse and does not stack with it.
